name: Mansa Devi Temple, Panchkula
summary: Mansa Devi of Panchkula — a major Haryana–Chandigarh region pilgrimage.
mythology: Mansa Devi Temple, Panchkula at Panchkula / foothills near Chandigarh, Haryana is dedicated to Goddess Mansa Devi, known especially for Popular Shivalik foothills Devi yatra. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Goddess Mansa Devi blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
